name: file
description: Perform a file operation inside the sandbox session.

args.old_string: Exact text to replace for edit

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: directory
description: Perform a directory operation inside the sandbox session: create, list, rename or delete (recursive).

args.path: Directory path inside the session root

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: terminal
description: Run one sandboxed command inside the session dir (cwd=workdir). Python libs via uv only, session-local: 'uv pip install --target .libs <pkg>', then 'python work/extract.py ...'. PYTHONPATH=.libs and UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache auto-set. Allowlist binaries only; no shell; timeout+output capped.

args.command: Command string or arg list (binary must be allowlisted: uv, python, python3, ...)
args.workdir: Working dir inside the session root (default '.')

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: search
description: Read-only search inside the sandbox session: glob file names or grep file contents with a regex, returning path/line/text. Skips build/cache dirs.

args.path: Directory or file inside the session root (default '.')

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: observe
description: Capture file facts for decide() inside the sandbox session: content + size + session in one call. Files only (no directories).

args.path: File path inside the session root

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: assertion
description: Run deterministic expectation checks (eq, ne, contains, regex, gte, lte, in) against supplied values or a JSON suite file inside the session. No eval; failing checks are reported, not raised.

args.suite_path: Optional JSON list inside the session root

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: trace
description: Read-only execution evidence: matching lines (regex) or the last N lines of one file inside the session, with 1-based line numbers and truncation flags.

args.path: File path inside the session root
args.tail: Last N lines when no pattern (default 50, max 200)

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()

name: scorecard
description: Weighted score from explicit rules: normalize each metric between min/max (inverted when higher_is_better is false) and return the weight-average plus a per-rule breakdown. Pure computation, no IO.

args.rules: List of {id, metric, weight, min, max, higher_is_better}

name: report
description: Render and save a report artifact (md or json) inside the session root; refuses to overwrite unless overwrite is true. Writes are approval-gated by the permission engine.

args.title: Report title
args.content: Optional raw text instead of sections
args.path: Output path inside the session root

sandbox.escapes: reject .., absolute and symlink escapes via resolve()
